test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Reverence
solution: The correct answer is '**Contempt**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Reverence**' is '**Contempt**'. • **Reverence**: a feeling of great respect. (श्रद्घा) • *Example: He is still held in great **reverence** throughout the country.* • **Contempt**: the feeling that somebody/something does not deserve any respect or is without value. (यह भावना कि कोई व्यक्ति सम्मान का हक़दार नहीं है तथा उसका कोई महत्व नहीं है; तिरस्‍कार, अवज्ञा) • *Example: The teacher treated my question with **contempt**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Contempt.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Respect**: the feeling that you have when you admire or have a high opinion of somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के प्रति आदर-भावना) • **Admiration**: a feeling of liking and respecting somebody/something very much. (किसी वस्‍तु या व्‍यक्ति के प्रति विशेष अनुराग और समादर की भावना) • **Awe**: feelings of respect and either fear or admiration. (भय या प्रशंसा से प्रेरित आदर भाव) 3b:T8a0, The correct answer is** 'aren't they'.**
